proposition: Existing G9 semantic concepts are sufficient for most BASE application classes; the dominant missing work is parser/compiler/runtime/stdlib/FFI.
falsifier: A mandatory app or FRANK subsystem requires a new semantic primitive after typed adapter/lowering options are exhausted.

proposition: WIT/WASI Component Model can serve as the first portable typed host-ABI target while Clay capability semantics remain externally enforced.
falsifier: Required Clay effect/resource/cancellation semantics cannot be represented without unsafe opaque escape hatches.

proposition: WASI 0.3 native async primitives reduce the amount of custom portable async ABI ClayCode needs.
falsifier: Cancellation, ordering, backpressure, or resource identity mismatches force Clay-specific runtime semantics beyond a thin mapping.

proposition: MLIR is a useful second-stage lowering/optimization substrate, but adding it before a minimal interpreter/direct Wasm path may slow the BASE gate.
falsifier: A small MLIR Clay dialect demonstrably reaches the mandatory app suite faster or with materially stronger correctness than direct lowering.

proposition: Schema-aware semantic_hash plus provenance-bound contract_hash is stable under set order/duplication while preserving ordered meaning.
falsifier: Mutation testing finds a collision/mis-normalization on typed ordered or semantically distinct data.

proposition: Every Wasm/native lowering needs differential/translation-validation receipts; successful compilation alone is insufficient.
falsifier: Matched source/target corpus shows target execution equivalence under the relevant Clay semantics and host adapters without differential checks adding failures.

proposition: Adaptive visual learner state can be expressed using existing records/deltas/provenance/version/rollback/capability primitives without new core language semantics.
falsifier: MVC-E1..E7 reference semantics expose an unrepresentable state transition or replay/version identity.

proposition: Typed host imports plus host-side capability possession is safer than granting ambient WASI/FFI access and then attempting to filter calls after the fact.
falsifier: Equivalent security/utility can be demonstrated with ambient access under a simpler verified enforcement model.

proposition: The current G9 surface grammar is not self-host-ready because it lacks syntax needed by the admitted G9-V3 cycle (`if` block at minimum).
falsifier: A conforming parser generated from the current EBNF accepts the exact G9-V3 cycle without grammar extension or undocumented preprocessing.
